body: Govern feat:catalog.snapshot-cache. Freeze shared public read models into the digest-checked source before snapshot finalization. Key caches by snapshot, projection version, route, filters and page; never label mutable rows immutable. Generate populated static details from those models. Use bounded public-only memory and IndexedDB caches, short-lived current-pointer revalidation, stable validators, and anonymous shared proxy caching. Exclude credentials, cookies, writes, health and failures. Verify isolation, 304 responses, warm visits, persistence, freshness transitions, SSR parity and responsive budgets. See docs/catalog-caching.md for the complete decision, contracts, rollout and evidence requirements. No deployment certification is implied.
context: Repeated visits currently refetch mutable public projections and show loading screens; compressed validators are unstable.
decision: Freeze shared public read models into verified snapshots; seed static HTML/query data; use bounded browser persistence and anonymous shared proxy caching.
requirements: Pinned reads never fall back to mutable entity rows.
A finalized snapshot pointer drives invalidation independently of deployment.
Authenticated, cookie-bearing, internal, health and write requests are not shared cached.
Conditional requests for unchanged data return 304 across accepted content encodings.
Repeat navigation and reload retain usable data; refresh and source evidence do not blank the page.
Cache memory, persistence, prefetch concurrency and stale fallback are bounded.
Static detail HTML, runtime projections and collection counts have parity.
deployment_status: Not deployed or certified by this change.
